runtime.statistic: median of per-invocation samples after warmup

memory.metric: peak traced Python-managed bytes for one invocation
limitations: does not fully capture native allocations made in C or extension modules

input_policy: deterministic format-specific sequence with documented seed; each method receives the same unchanged list for each format and size
interpretation_guardrail: Measurements are environment-specific descriptive evidence only. Do not infer universal algorithm rankings or impose performance thresholds across hosts.
